title: Item:Dust of Mythic Power

__NOTOC__ * All Dusts of Mythic Power are Bound to Account on Acquire. * Dusts of Mythic Power will disappear from player inventories when [[Sterling's Remnant Rush]], the event they drop from, ends on April 1st, 2027.
